text:
RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: not reliably quantifiable from the information provided

An all-male panel is a reasonable process concern to raise, but it does not by itself establish sex discrimination. Giving a percentage would imply evidence we don’t have.

Your PhD and eight years of leadership make your question legitimate, but higher academic qualifications don’t automatically outweigh management experience; the advertised criteria matter.

Follow up now for the written explanation, asking how candidates were assessed against those criteria. You can neutrally ask how panel membership was determined and whether any gender-balance policy applies.

If the explanation reveals inconsistent criteria, sex stereotypes or procedural breaches, seek advice from your union or an employment adviser. Check local complaint deadlines rather than waiting indefinitely.
